about: Outcomes recorded from the real core/behavior.c (jelli_behavior_stimulus then jelli_behavior_step for one behaviour second; idle is queued after the stimulus when no state runs) at commit a75df7d, for the behaviour document and vocabulary below. test_creatures.py replays them through simulator.js. after is the state index after that second (-1 for none) and left its remaining seconds (999 for a state that kept running).
